title: Centralised Audit Service
summary: Kafka-backed audit infrastructure for transaction investigations and financial traceability.
problem: Compliance and operations teams need a dependable trail through activity spanning multiple services.
implementation: Architected and owned audit infrastructure capturing immutable financial events and user actions. Delivery covered implementation, tests, deployment, monitoring and production support.
decisions: Preserve stable operation identities in audit events.
Keep ingestion asynchronous and processing bounded.
Connect structured events to investigation and monitoring workflows.
results: 5–10 million daily transactions in the client scope.

title: IRIS - Core Banking Payment Gateway
summary: Engineered an internal ISO 20022/SWIFT payment gateway with Netty TCP connection management, gRPC contracts, digital signatures, idempotency, and production recovery for Tier-1 bank workloads.
problem: Inter-bank payment messages need validation, secure delivery and a recoverable state when connections or acknowledgements fail.
implementation: Engineered the IRIS gateway and transfer engine with Netty TCP connection management, gRPC contracts, ISO 20022/SWIFT flows, canonicalisation and digital signatures.
decisions: Separate transport delivery from business completion so a lost acknowledgement is not treated as proof of failure.
Keep stable transaction references and duplicate protection across timeout and recovery paths.
Use deterministic regression cases for malformed, delayed and failed-message scenarios.
results: 98% reduction in failures in the affected payment flows.

title: PRM - Real-Time Payment Risk Engine
summary: Architected a non-intrusive payment-risk framework using Spring AOP/AspectJ, CQRS, Redis, graceful degradation, and immutable audit trails for regulated financial workflows.
problem: Payment-risk evaluation must support investigations without introducing an uncontrolled dependency into every transaction path.
implementation: Built the PRM payment-risk framework around transaction attributes, Redis-backed state, reviewable decisions and immutable audit trails.
decisions: Evaluate explicit transaction attributes with reproducible decision context.
Use graceful degradation and reviewable outcomes for dependency failures.
Connect fraud investigation support to audit evidence rather than making opaque, irreversible decisions.

results: Focused regression coverage for updates, renames, persistence and conflicts.
